description: This file contains the PHP class 'SaleTax' within the OpenCart admin extension report namespace. It defines a controller for handling sale tax reports, including functions for displaying the report, saving settings, and generating report data. The file is part of the OpenCart admin backend for tax-related sales reports.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale tax reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale tax report form page, setting up breadcrumbs and loading the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings related to sale tax reports, handling permission checks and returning JSON status.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the sale tax report, including filtering options, pagination, and report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of sale tax report data as a JSON response.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Compiles and returns the HTML for the sale tax report based on current filters and data.
